name: clean-architecture-marketplace
description: Учебный пример: маркетплейс на NestJS по принципам Clean / Hexagonal Architecture

scripts.start:all: npm run build && concurrently --names basket,discount,warehouse,delivery --prefix-colors blue,magenta,yellow,green "npm start -w services/basket" "npm start -w services/discount" "npm start -w services/warehouse" "npm start -w services/delivery"
